steps.heading: loc vs. iloc
steps.body: loc selects by label (what the index/column is actually named); iloc selects by integer position (where it sits), regardless of what the labels say. Mixing them up is one of the most common early pandas bugs.

steps.heading: Position vs. label
steps.output: # first 3 rows, by position — labels don't matter here
steps.caption: Compare to df.loc[:3], which is label-based and would include the row actually labeled 3.

steps.heading: Boolean indexing
steps.body: df[condition] filters rows using a boolean Series — the same shape as a column, but True/False instead of data. It's the single most common way to filter a DataFrame.
